purpose: Prevent recurrence of resized or flattened MUGEN stage reconstruction. The stage must keep native world dimensions and be viewed through a Mega Drive viewport with camera and tile streaming.

mugen_stage_rules_required: mask=1 applies index-0 transparency before layer composition
BG sections render in sequential back-to-front order
start offsets are applied in world coordinates
tile flags repeat sprites to fill the stage region

sgdk_streaming_contract.runtime_policy: Rebuild the active 42x30 tile window when the camera crosses an 8px tile boundary. Upload only unique tiles required by the current window, then write the BG_A tilemap with palette and H/V flip flags.

anti_magenta_gate.failure_meaning: Transparency or layer composition failed before SGDK export.

native_scale_gate.failure_meaning: The MUGEN stage was resized or flattened instead of reconstructed as a camera-driven world.

camera_coverage_gate.failure_meaning: The viewer cannot expose the full reconstructed stage extents.

curation_notes: This report describes a training fixture behavior, not a global canonical tool promotion.
Future agents must not replace the camera/streaming contract with image downscaling to fit 320x224.
Future canonicalization should add wrapper-native VDP dump evidence for the active tile cache.
